notes: Tuition: the €15,000 figure is quoted both on the programme page for 2027/2028 and on the non-EU direct-admission page ("one-off annual contribution"), which is the page for non-EU applicants with foreign qualifications; it is a single 'single fee' not differentiated by income brackets. Note the Bachelor's degree fee table on the Student Affairs Office page also states €15,000 for Bachelor's Degrees (2027/2028). Intakes: only the first certification selection session is shown; the quote states submission of applications 'From October 2026 to 10 February 2027' and registration 'By 4 May 2027'; more sessions/rounds may exist in the Admission Notice published from October 2026. The full admission notice with eligibility requirements, selection procedures and deadlines will be published from October 2026.
